 The Abu Dhabi T10 2026 continues on Saturday, 14 November, with three more fixtures bringing another round of fast-paced cricket and match predictions.
 Here are the Predictions for Abu Dhabi T10 2026, 16th Match - Royal Desert Champions vs United Tigers; 17th Match - Arabian Aces vs Emirates Eagles and 18th Match - Yas Lions vs UAE Bulls, to be played on the 14th of November at the Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi.
 Points Table 
 16th Match - Royal Desert Champions vs United Tigers (Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi ) 
Ground Stat:
Average 1st Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 116
Average 2nd Innings Total at Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi (Abu Dhabi T10) - 105
 Current Form United Tigers:
 United Tigers are currently placed at the 1st position on points table with 4 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 8 points to their name. 
The top run scorer for United Tigers in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Fakhar Zaman with 155 runs to his name.
The top wicket taker for United Tigers in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Abbas Afridi with 7 scalps under his belt.
 United Tigers have won their previous match against Emirates Eagles by 22 runs. 
United Tigers batted first and they posted a total of 141 for 5 in 10 overs. Sahibzada Farhan got out without troubling the scorers much. After his dismissal, Fakhar Zaman and Joe Clarke carried the innings forward with knocks of 26 and 33 runs respectively. It was Azmatullah Omarzai, who literally smashed the bowlers to all parts. He scored 33 runs off only 9 balls to help United Tigers get to a tall total of 141 in 10 overs of play.
During the chase, Emirates Eagles lost the key wicket of Kyle Mayers quite early. After his dismissal, Alex Hales fought hard. He scored 67 off 31 balls but his partners couldn't keep up with the required rate. As a result, Emirates Eagles were eventually restricted to 119 for 2 in 10 overs, losing the match by 22 runs.
 Current Form Royal Desert Champions:
 Royal Desert Champions are currently placed at the 4th position on points table with 2 wins and 3 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. 
The top run scorer for Royal Desert Champions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Phil Salt with 107 runs to his name.
The top wicket taker for Royal Desert Champions in the Abu Dhabi T10 League is Naseem Shah with 3 scalps under his belt.
 Royal Desert Champions have won their previous match against Yas Lions by a big margin of 39 runs. 
Royal Desert Champions batted first and they posted a total of 136 for 4 in 10 overs. Phil Salt and Brandon King started off very well for Royal Desert Champions. They added 46 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Salt got out after scoring 24 runs while King went on to make 66 runs in 28 deliveries. Nicholas Pooran also played a vital knock of 26 runs off 11 balls as Royal Desert Champions managed to reach a massive total of 136 in 10 overs of play.
During the chase, Yas Lions lost their way right from the word go. They were reduced to 24 for 4 in the 5th over itself. Naseem Shah bowled exceptionally well. He picked up 3 wickets for 17 runs and triggered the collapse. Tom Moores made 40 off 21 balls but it didn't make much of a difference as Yas Lions were eventually restricted to 97 for 6 in 10 overs, losing the match by 39 runs.
